content:
The test suite failed because it attempted to use an unsupported '--recalculate' flag with the 'ssconvert' command-line utility.
The verifier encountered a subprocess.CalledProcessError when running 'ssconvert' on '/root/output/result.xlsx'. The error message explicitly stated: "Unknown option --recalculate". This occurred within the _recalculate_with_ssconvert function in /tests/test_outputs.py, causing multiple test cases (test_file_and_sheet_structure, test_lookup_blocks, test_derived_values_and_stats) to fail during the workbook loading phase.
